text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — we need a compact intake for the three-cloud listing. Biggest open items: EULA final, hero image + logo release, AMI/GCP image + ARM builds, SKU/pricing rows, entitlement rules for trials, publisher IDs, and any legal notices (KMS, telemetry). Who can pick up what?

Alex Torres: Ill take images (AWS AMIs + GCP images). Need publisher IDs and any acceptance tests the marketplaces require. Will produce x86 + arm64.

Samir Patel: On KMS/keys: legal asked whether to show BYOK. Public listing should say: hosted uses Redwood-managed keys; BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private. I can draft the short blurb and telemetry opt-in text.

Carla Nguyen: Legal wants final EULA PDF, trademark/logo release, and the incident contact (email + escalation). Also need to confirm trial terms (duration, token cap, rate limits). I can collate templates but need the product bullet points for SLAs.

Maya Chen: Publisher IDs for reference: AWS account 123456789012, GCP project redwood-marketplace-prod, Azure publisher redwood-csp-sub. Alex, well DM infra to confirm. Example AMI naming convention to use in metadata: redwood-inference-ami-ubuntu22-<region>-<arch>-2026-03

Alex Torres: Got it. Ill bake cloud-init that writes /etc/marketplace-validation with the validation token. ETA: AWS AMIs EOD Tue, GCP images Wed. Will post image IDs here.

Samir Patel: Draft KMS line: "Customer-managed keys supported in Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted API uses Redwood-managed encryption keys by default." Carla, ok to shrink to one sentence?

Carla Nguyen: Yes, shorten but add a retention/export policy line: "We retain minimal telemetry; no PII is exported. See privacy addendum." Ill attach EULA and logo release once signed.

MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MP-4832: "marketplace listing intake - redwood inference" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-4832

Maya Chen: SKU proposal: RedwoodInference.Standard (hosted API) and RedwoodInference.Dedicated (reserved capacity). Pricing rows: hourly list, monthly commit tiers, and a 30-day trial entitlement (token-limited). Product: confirm default quotas we expose.

Carla Nguyen: Legal ok with SKU naming. Need product to provide quotas (tokens/day, max rps) for trial text. Also add support SLA bullets (response time, severity matrix).

Alex Torres: Note for marketplace QA: include a small smoke script that returns 200 from /health and places a validation file. Ill include that in the image.

Samir Patel: Telemetry blurb: "We collect anonymized usage metrics to improve service reliability; customers may opt-out for Dedicated/Private." Will add non-PII note.

Maya Chen: Action items: Alex = images + validation artifacts, post IDs; Carla = EULA, logo release, trial legal language; Samir = KMS + telemetry blurb; Maya = upload hero assets + open the intake doc. Target: submit portal intake by Friday COB.

Alex Torres: +1, will update with AMI IDs.

Carla Nguyen: Uploading documents now; will link PDF here when ready.

Samir Patel: Dropping draft blurb into the intake doc in 30m.

Maya Chen: Scheduling a brief follow-up Thu 9am PT. Reply + if you can make it.

Alex Torres: +

Samir Patel: +

Carla Nguyen: +

Maya Chen: Thanks team.
